name: Kannonji Castle
description: Kannonji Castle was the vast hilltop base of the Rokkaku clan, said to have been the largest castle of the Sengoku period. Terraced kuruwa and stone walls spread across the mountain; it is a national historic site.
notes: Free open-air ruins; the climb from the Kannonji temple area takes about an hour.
